title: Rewind of the virtual host
statement: Let $x,y$ be Boolean words, let $c$ be a configuration of the rewind machine on input $y$ with state start, let $b$ be a Boolean boundary tag satisfying the virtual-head boundary condition for $c$'s input-head position, let $p$ be a valid input-head position for input $x$, and let $\mathrm{pre}$ be a Boolean word. There exist a natural number $u\le c$'s input-head position $+2$ and a Boolean tag $b'$ such that after $u$ steps of the virtual-host simulation of the zero-work-tape rewind machine, the configuration is the virtual host of $c$ with halting state and input-head position $1$, tag $b'$, position $p$, and output prefix $\mathrm{pre}$; its buffer head is at the origin and its buffer tape stores $y$.
hypotheses_covered: $c$ is a zero-work-tape configuration of the rewind machine on input $y$
$b$ satisfies the virtual boundary-tag condition for $c$'s input-head position
$p$ is a valid input-head position for input $x$
